# SemanticRole

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

PDF structure-element role. Maps directly to one of the standard structure types in ISO 32000-1 §14.8.4 (grouping, headings, paragraph, list, table, inline, illustration, navigation, and artifact).

String form via `toPdfTag` is the value that appears in PDF dictionaries (the leading `/` is added by the writer, not stored here).

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Values

- `Document`: Document - top-level grouping element. The builder auto-creates a Document root.
- `Sect`: Sect - a section.
- `Art`: Art - an article.
- `Div`: Div - a generic division.
- `BlockQuote`: BlockQuote - a block quotation.
- `Caption`: Caption - caption associated with a Figure / Formula / Form / Table.
- `TOC`: TOC - table of contents container.
- `TOCI`: TOCI - a single TOC item.
- `Index`: Index - a structured index.
- `H`: H - generic heading (level inferred from context).
- `H1`: H1 - heading level 1.
- `H2`: H2 - heading level 2.
- `H3`: H3 - heading level 3.
- `H4`: H4 - heading level 4.
- `H5`: H5 - heading level 5.
- `H6`: H6 - heading level 6.
- `P`: P - paragraph.
- `L`: L - a list.
- `LI`: LI - a list item (the row).
- `Lbl`: Lbl - a list item label (bullet, number, …).
- `LBody`: LBody - a list item body (the content of the item).
- `Table`: Table - table grouping.
- `TR`: TR - table row.
- `TH`: TH - table header cell.
- `TD`: TD - table data cell.
- `THead`: THead - table header section.
- `TBody`: TBody - table body section.
- `TFoot`: TFoot - table footer section.
- `Span`: Span - generic inline grouping.
- `Quote`: Quote - inline quotation.
- `Note`: Note - footnote or endnote.
- `Reference`: Reference - cross-reference.
- `BibEntry`: BibEntry - bibliography entry.
- `Code`: Code - inline code or computer output.
- `Link`: Link - hyperlink wrapper. Used around the visible link text; the actual `/Link` annotation references this structure element via `/OBJR`.
- `Annot`: Annot - generic annotation reference.
- `Figure`: Figure - an illustration / image.
- `Formula`: Formula - a mathematical formula.
- `Form`: Form - a form widget.
- `Artifact`: Artifact - content that is not part of the logical document order (page headers, footers, watermarks, decorative borders). Required by PDF/UA for any drawn content that is not otherwise tagged.
